scenarios.description: Control: identical state and parameters, never stimulated. How much of the phosphate rise is the initial condition rather than the exercise is measured, not asserted: index.rest_control carries the fraction and both arms' numbers.

The same ten repetitions with SOCE off — the comparison arm for the calcium store, NOT for force: the two arms' force curves overlap and cross (index.comparison). expt 4 takes the g_SOCE = 0 branch at dydt.m:542-546, whose comment reads 'Expt 2,4,6,8 have no SOCE.'
Ten sprint repetitions with store-operated calcium entry, then rest.

The same stress with CaMKK2 knocked out (kCaMKK = 0). It does not separate from wild type: 2-DG is an energy stimulus, not a calcium one, so the calcium arm of AMPK activation has almost nothing to do here. Shipped because a comparison arm that fails to differ is a result.
The same stress with LKB1 knocked out (kLKB1 = LKB1tot = 0, the authors' own surgery). The sensor barely rises — LKB1 is what phosphorylates AMPK under this stimulus.

The authors' 2-DG energy stress on the wild-type model: 1000 s at basal metabolism, then calcium to 0.25 uM and glycolysis cut 100-fold for 1800 s. This is the protocol Supplemental Table 13's sensitivity analysis is computed over, and that table reproduces 72/72 here.

The control for the coupling: identical calcium, identical model, identical parameters, ATP demand held flat at its resting value. Whatever separates this from ampk_francis_soce_on is the energy cost of the bout and nothing else.

Paper 1 driving paper 2: our ten-repetition Francis run supplies calcium and ATP hydrolysis to the AMPK model through the interface exercise.ipynb defines. The AMPK model is the authors' and so is the stimulus shape (p.17); the input file is ours, because the two files their notebook reads were never published.

The coupled bout with CaMKK2 knocked out (kCaMKK = 0, the authors' own surgery). Identical calcium and demand to ampk_francis_soce_on; whatever separates the two is what the calcium arm was doing. The paper's Figure 8C: exercise-induced AMPK activity depends strongly on CaMKK2.
The coupled bout with LKB1 knocked out (kLKB1 = LKB1tot = 0). The sensor starts dark — LKB1 carries the resting phosphorylation — and the bout's calcium, through CaMKK2, lifts it part of the way.

One 45-minute endurance bout from the same baseline. Upstream this runs beta-adrenergic -> cAMP -> ROS — a different half of the network — but read the index before drawing the twelve phenotypes: they barely differ.
One 45-minute resistance bout from the authors' 15-hour baseline, both exercise inputs otherwise at zero. Upstream this runs integrin -> Smad -> calcium/LPA.
OURS, not the paper's: the same 45 minutes with neither input on. The control. Anything the two bout arms share with this one is the network settling, not exercise.
